title: Ladnier's death at Mezz's house
summary: Ladnier died at Mezz Mezzrow's house with a pad and pencil in hand. Zutty and Buck Washington, who lived in the Singletons' building on 47th Street, went there.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: (And he died in Mezz's house you know.

And he had a pad and a pencil looked like he was going to write something, but he never did get a chance to write it. And Mezz called, called me up and told me about it and I happened to see Buck or something and Buck and I went on............
Well Buck was, well we were living in the same building, you know?
You know he and (Fletcher?) were living there right where we were living on 47th Street
Yes. Yes, that was where he was.

Lovely. I don't know, I think, well he wasn't getting any work, Tommy, and I think he had just gotten disgusted with it. And you remember that (line?) that I'm always telling his family, when with us he stood out on 7th Avenue/just explaining this Rosicrucianist religion, trying to make us understand. Like he wanted us to get involved in it, you know?
